title: Jamaican Grater Cake
ingredients:
2 cups grated coconut
2 cup white sugar
1/4 cup water
1/4 tsp ground ginger
1/4 tsp ground cinnamon
1/4 tsp ground nutmeg
1/4 tsp salt
1 teaspoon(s) red food colouring
method:
1. Preheat your oven to 350°F (180°C). Grease an 8-inch (20 cm) square baking dish and set aside.
2. In a large bowl, combine the grated coconut, brown sugar, ginger, cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt. Mix well.
3. In a separate small saucepan, heat the water over medium heat until it starts to simmer.
4. Add the hot water to the coconut mixture and stir well to combine.
5. Pour the coconut mixture into the prepared baking dish and use a spoon or spatula to press it down evenly.
6. Bake the greater cake in the preheated oven for 30-35 minutes, or until it is golden brown on top and a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
7. Remove the greater cake from the oven and let it cool in the baking dish for 10-15 minutes.
8. Use a sharp knife to cut the greater cake into squares or diamond shapes.

title: Jamaican Blue Draws
ingredients:
2 lbs sweet potato, peeled and grated
1 1/2 cups grated coconut
1/2 tsp ground cinnamon
1/2 tsp ground nutmeg
1/2 tsp ground allspice
1/2 tsp salt
1/2 cup brown sugar
1/2 cup all-purpose flour
1/2 cup water
Banana leaves or aluminum foil
method:
1. Preheat your oven to 350°F (180°C). Grease a 9-inch (23 cm) baking dish and set aside.
2. In a large bowl, combine the sweet potato, grated coconut, cinnamon, nutmeg, allspice, salt, and brown sugar. Mix well.
3. In a separate bowl, mix together the flour and water until smooth. Add this mixture to the sweet potato and coconut mixture and stir well to combine.
4. Cut the banana leaves or aluminum foil into 8-10 inch (20-25 cm) squares. Place a few spoonfuls of the sweet potato mixture onto each leaf or foil square.
5. Fold the leaf or foil around the sweet potato mixture, creating a pouch or "draw". Tie the top with a string or banana leaf strip.
6. Arrange the draws in the greased baking dish, and bake in the preheated oven for 45-50 minutes, or until the sweet potato is tender and the draws are firm.
7. Remove the draws from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes before opening the leaf or foil pouches.

title: Gizzadas
ingredients:
FILLING
1 Large coconut peeled and grated
2 Cups granulated sugar
1 ½  Cup water
1 tsp. Almond
1 tsp. Nutmeg
Cherries colour
PASTRY
1lb. flour (Counter, all purpose, cake)
8oz Margarine (Gold seal)
¼ tsp. Salt
Cold water
method:
1. Combine coconut, sugar, water, almond, and nutmeg.
2. Put to cook until all liquid has evaporated.
3. Sieve flour in bowl in margarine using forger tips until the mixture Resembles fine breadcrumbs.
4. Bring dough together with cold water.
5. Roll out pastry about ½ inch thick and cut out rounds
6. Make shells, prick the bottom and fill with coconut top with a cherry.
7. Bake for 20-25 minutes at 400F.

title: Sausage Rolls
ingredients:
PASTRY
6 oz Rich Short crust pastry [cake or pastry flour]
½ lb. Sausages
Egg or Milk for brushing
method:
1. Make the pastry and roll out thinly to a rectangle.
2. Cut the sausages into 2 inch length.
3. Place these on the pastry in two rows.
4. Wet between each sausage and around the edges.
5. Fold the pastry from the top and bottom into the center and press lightly to form rolls.
6. Cut each roll separately and flake the edges and mark the top with a knife.
7. Brush with egg or milk and bake in a hot oven for 25-30 minutes.

title: Plantain Tarts
ingredients:
FILLING
1 large ripe plantain (boiled, drained and crushed)
½  cup g. sugar
1 Tsp red colouring [gel or powder]
½  tsp. cinnamon
½   tsp. nutmeg
2 tsp. vanilla
PASTRY
1 lb flour
8 oz margarine
method:
1. Make up pastry' as for gizzards
2. Roll out and cut into squares
3. Spoon filling in the center of each square
4. Brush edges with water, fold pastry and seal
5. Prick with fork, brush with egg whites and sprinkle with granulated sugar and bake at 400°F at 25 minutes.

title: Beef Patties
ingredients:
5 cups sifted cake & Pastry Flour
Iced cold water as needed
1 tsp. Salt
1 cup beef suet
½  cup shortening and extra for spread
¾  tsp. Egg powder colouring

FILLING
 1 lb. Beef mince
1 tbsp.	Soya sauce
1 tsp.	Worstershire sauce
1 tsp.	Browning
2-stalks escallion, chopped
1 medium onion, chopped
1 hot pepper [to taste]
2 sprigs thyme
Breadcrumbs to thicken filling
[cooking oil 2tbsp]
method:
Combine flour, salt and egg powder colouring. Cut shortening and beef suet into flour mixture.
1. Add enough ice water to make small dough (not too sticky). Shape into a ball.
2. On a floured surface, roll dough into a rectangle shape.
3. With the extra shortening spread across evenly on 2/3 thirds of the dough. Fold the 1/3 of the dough that has no fat to the center and place the other 1/3 of the dough that has fat on top of the folded dough.
4. Make a half turn clockwise ensuring that the dough spine is on the left hand side. Roll to a rectangle shape
5. Repeat this procedure of rolling and folding 4 more times. On the last fold DO NOT ROLL OUT.
6. Place dough into a refrigerator and chill 30 mins. –1 hr. Remove from fridge and roll out to desired thickness.
7. Using a small saucer or plate cut out the desired sizes for patties.
8. Add filling as needed for patty size_ Moist the edges and fold in half. Using a fork, crimp the edges to seal the filling inside
9. Bake in a pre-heated oven at 400°Ffor 35-40 mins or until when touched the top is crispy.
FILLING INSTRUCTIONS FOR BEEF PATTIES
1. Add chopped seasoning to pan with 2 tbsp. cooking oil.
2. Sauté to release flavours.
3. Add tap water, enough which will cover the meat.
4. Add the seasoned meat to pan of water and sautéed seasonings.
5. Make sure that the meat is well incorporated with the water; breaking up as you stir, this allows the meat not to clump together.
6. Cover and cook 15 rains.
7. Taste and adjust seasonings and salt. Add sauces and browning. Simmer. Thicken with breadcrumbs.
8. Allow cooling before filling pastry.

title: Pinwheel Cookies
ingredients:
Choco-Mint
Yield (3 dozen)
INGREDIENTS
1 Square unsweetened baking chocolate
½ Cup unsalted butter (125mL)
½ Cup vegetable shortening (125mL)
1 Cup granulated sugar (250mL)
1 Egg
1 Tsp. mint flavouring (5mL)
2 Cups all purpose flour (500mL 1 Egg white, lightly beaten
Green food colouring
method:
1. Melt chocolate in top of double-boiler and set aside.
2. In a large bowl, cream butter and shortening with sugar. Add egg and mint flavouring; mix well. Gradually mix in flour.
3. Divide dough into 2 portions. To the first portion, add a few drops of green food colouring and blend well. To the second, add melted chocolate and blend well. Wrap each portion in waxed paper and chill in refrigerator about 1 hour, or until firm enough to roll.
4. Roll each portion on floured waxed paper into a rectangle about 10 x 12 inches (25 x 30 cm), 1/4 (5mm) thick.
5. Brush one (1) rectangle with some egg white. Lifting by the waxed paper, carefully place second rectangle on top of first, and gently press together. Trim edges to make an even rectangle, and brush top with remaining egg white.
6. Starting from the long end, use waxed paper to roll dough. Wrap in waxed paper and transfer roll to refrigerator. Chill until firm, about three hours.
7. Preheat oven to 375°f (190°C); lightly grease a cookie.
8. Cut roll into 1/4 inch (5mm) slices, discarding irregular end pieces. Transfer to cookie sheet and bake 10 to 12 minutes until they start to firm. When done, transfer to wire racks and let cool.

MINT RASBERRY
Yield 6 dozen
INGREDIENTS
1/2 Cup unsalted butter (125mL)
 4oz Cream cheese (125g)
1 Cup granulated sugar (250ml)
1 Egg
1 Tsp. lemon juice (5ml)
1 Tbsp. Chopped lemon zest (15ml)
 2 1/4 Cups all-purpose flour (550mL)
1/2 Tsp. baking soda (2ml)
1 Cup raspberry jam (250ml)
INSTRUCTIONS
1. In a large bowl, cream butter and cream cheese with sugar. Add egg, juice and lemon zest; continue beating until light and fluffy.
2. Sift flour and baking soda together. Gradually add to creamed mixture, blending after each addition. Chill for 1 hour.
3. Preheat oven to 350°F (180°C); lightly grease cookie sheets.
4. Divide dough in three. Working on floured board, roll one portion into 'a rectangle, about 9 x 10 inches (23 x 25 cm) and 1/8 inch (3mm) thick. Trim edges. Brush with 1/4 of raspberry jam and roll up. Repeat with remaining portions of dough and jam.
5. Cut rolls into slices and place on cookie sheet. Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until firm. When done, transfer to wire racks and let cool.

title: Tiramisu
ingredients:
6 egg yolks
3/4 cup sugar
2/3 cup milk
1 1/4 cups heavy cream
1/2 tsp vanilla extract
1 lb mascarpone cheese
1/4 cup strong coffee or espresso
24-30 ladyfingers
Cocoa powder, for dusting
method:
1. In a large mixing bowl, beat the egg yolks and sugar together until pale and thick. Set aside.
2. In a medium saucepan, heat the milk over low heat until it just starts to simmer.
3. Pour the hot milk over the egg yolk mixture, whisking constantly.
4. Return the mixture to the saucepan and cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until it thickens and coats the back of a spoon.
5. Remove the saucepan from the heat and let the mixture cool to room temperature.
6. In a separate bowl, beat the heavy cream and vanilla extract until stiff peaks form.
7. In another mixing bowl, beat the mascarpone cheese until it is smooth.
8. Gently fold the cooled egg yolk mixture into the mascarpone cheese.
9. Fold in the whipped cream until everything is well combined.
10. Pour the coffee or espresso into a shallow dish.
11. Dip each ladyfinger into the coffee or espresso for a few seconds, then arrange them in a single layer in the bottom of a 9x13 inch (23x33 cm) baking dish.
12. Spread half of the mascarpone mixture over the ladyfingers.
13. Repeat with another layer of dipped ladyfingers and the remaining mascarpone mixture.
14. Cover the baking dish with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, or overnight.
15. Before serving, dust the top of the Tiramisu with cocoa powder.

title: Cherry Cheese Pie
ingredients:
CRUST
3 Packs tea biscuits
1/4 Cup Sugar
1 Stick Melted Margarine

FILLING
1/2 lb Cream cheese
1 tin Condensed Milk
1/3 Cup lime juice
3 tsp Vanilla
method:
1. Cream cheese first then gradually add condensed milk
2. Add lime juice and Vanilla
3. Mill well then pour into pie hell
4. Bake at 300 F until firm to the touch.

TOPPING
Cherry, Blueberry, Strawberry, Raspberry

title: Apple Pie
ingredients:
FILLING
7 apple (peeled and sliced)
1 cup g. sugar
4 tbsp. corn-starch
1 tsp. cinnamon
1 tsp. nutmeg
dash salt
2 tbsp. margarine
PASTRY
8oz margarine
1 lb flour
method:
1.Make up pastry and line pie plate with pastry
2 Combine apples and rest of ingredients together except margarine. Pour into lined pastry pan and dot with margarine.
3 Cover with top crust, brush with water and sprinkle with sugar. Bake at 400°F for 50 minutes.

title: Pineapple Pie
ingredients:
FILLING
5 lb pineapple
8oz g. Sugar
2 drops yellow food colour
3 tblsp corn-starch
Cherries to decorate

PASTRY
8oz margarine 1 LB flour
cold water to mix
method:
1. Peel pineapple and remove eyes
2. Cut into small cubes and put to cook with sugar and yellow food colouring in about 3 cups water until tender, then thicker with corn-starch.
3. Make up pastry and line pie pan with pastry
4. Pour in filling and lay strips of dough in lattice pattern. Decorate with cherries
5. Bake at 400°F for about 45-50 minutes.

title: Key Lime Pie
ingredients:
CRUST
2 pack tea biscuit
1/2 cup sugar
1/2 stick margarine melted
method:
Crust biscuits fine until it have the resemblance of breadcrumbs. Mix all above ingredients together, then press into pie plate firmly and bake shallow for 5 minutes at 300 oF or refrigerate until filling is ready.
INGREDIENTS
3 egg yolks
1 can condensed milk
4 oz lime (1/2 cup)
Yellow or green food colouring 3 egg white
1/4 cup sugar
cherries to decorate

Preheat oven to 325F in large bowl beat egg yolk with condensed milk, lime juice and food colouring. Pour into the crust and bake for 40 mins. Whip the egg whites with sugar until stiff peak form.
Spread it on top of the pie and brown in a 425 F preheat cool chill.

title: Lemon Meringue Pie
ingredients:
1 cup Sugar
1/4 cup Cornstarch
1 ½ cups Water
3 Egg yolks
Grated peel of 1 lemon
1/4 cup Lemon juice
1 tbsp	Margarine
3 Egg whites
1/3 cup Sugar
1 Prebaked 9" Pie Crust (1 lb Cake & Pastry Flour 8 oz Butter).
method:
1. Combine sugar, corn-starch and water in a saucepan. Bring to boil stirring constantly and cook until thickened.
2. Stir in egg yolks. Cook over low heat for 1 minute stirring constantly.
3. Stir in lemon juice, lemon zest and margarine. Cook for 1 minute more. Cool.
4. Pour into crust.
5. Whip egg whites until foamy, gradually beat in sugar until the egg whites form stiff peaks.
6. Place egg whites on top of the filling and swirl. Place in a preheated 450°F oven for   minutes.

title: Benjamin Easter Bun
ingredients:
3 cups all-purpose flour
1 cup dark sugar
1 bottle stout
1 1/2 cup fruit (raisin, mixed peel cherries chopped)
1 tbsp marmalade
3 tsp. Margarine
1 tbsp strawberry jam
1 tsp. Cinnamon
2 tbsp vanilla.
1 1/4 cup honey
1 tbsp. Molasses
1 tsp. Nutmeg tbsp browning
2 tsp. Baking Powder
method: Preheat oven 350°. Greased pan generously. Warm stout, sugar, molasses, honey, marmalade jam, margarine and browning in saucepan stirring until dissolved. Sift flour cinnamon, baking powder and nutmeg, add chopped fruits to mixture. Add liquid to flour mixture including vanilla mixing until properly blended. Pour mixture into greased pan and bake for 1 hour Or until cake tester inserted in center comes out clean. Apply honey glaze when cool.

title: Coffee Cake
ingredients:
Mix topping for Coffee Cake before mixing cake.

INGREDIENTS
TOPPING:
1/2 cup brown sugar
1 table spoon flour
1 tsp. Cinnamon
1 table spoon melted butter
1/2 cup broken nuts

CAKE:
 1/2 cup salad oil or melted shortening
1 beaten egg
1/2 cup milk
1 1/2 cup sifted flour
3/4 sugar
2 tsp. Baking powder
1/2 tsp. Salt
method:
1. Combine brown sugar, flour, cinnamon, melted butter and 1/2 cup broken Nuts for topping (almonds, walnuts etc.) Set aside.
2. Preheat oven to 3750F about 15 minutes.
3. Grease a 9 x9x2 inch pan.
4. Combine salad oil, egg and milk
5. Sift together dry ingredients
6. Add milk mixture and mix with dry ingredients.
7. Pour into greased pan.
8. Sprinkle topping over batter and bake for about 25 minutes or until done.
9. Serve warm.

title: Muffins
ingredients:
2 cups flour
1 cup raisin$ 
1\2 cup sugar
4 tsp baking powder
1\2 tsp xeci
3 oz melted margarine
1 cup milk
1 egg
method:
Sift all dry ingredients together in a bowl and add raisins.
Combine milk, egg and melted margarine together.
Blend together liquid and dry ingredient mixing only until
the flour is moistened.
Pour into greased muffin pan and bake at 400°f 25-30 mins.

title: Corn Bread
ingredients:
1 1/4 Cups Flour
3/4 cups cornmeal
1/4 cup Sugar
4 1/2 tsp. Baking Powder 1/2 tsp. Salt
1 egg Beaten
2/3 cups Milk — 162-LIO.
1/3 cup melted Margarine
method:
1.	Preheat oven 425 of for approximately 15 minutes.
2.	Grease loaf tin (8x4).
3.	Sift dry ingredients.
4.	Mix well-beaten eggs, with milk and melted margarine.
5.	Pour milk mixture in dry ingredients. Do not over mix, as this may cause tunnels.
6.	Pour in greased loaf tin and bake for approximately 30 minutes.
7.	Serve hot.

title: Carrot Cake
ingredients:
1 cup Oil
 1 ½ Granulated sugar (mix together until creamy)
8 Eggs
1 cup Nuts
3 cups Baking flour
2 tbsp baking powder (mix together blend into the above)
1 tbsp Cinnamon
1tbsp Nutmeg
1oz Vanilla
3 cups Carrots (grated)
1 cup Raisins
TOPPING
8oz Cream Cheese
8oz Unsalted Butter (mix until light)
2lb Icing Sugar
method:
1. In a large bowl, beat the eggs until very light and frothy.
2. Add the sugar gradually, beating until very light.
3. Gradually whip in the oil.
4. Sift together the flour with baking powder, salt and cinnamon
5. Slowly add to the egg mixture
6. Stir in the carrots, raisins, nuts and vanilla.
7. Pour into a greased 9 inches spring form pan and bake in a preheated 350 "F
8. Bake for 1 ½ - 2 hours

title: Coconut Rum & Raisin Bread Pudding
ingredients:
18 slices Sandwich Bread
6 tbsp Butter
1 tsp Mixed Spice
3 cups	Coconut Milk (Evaporated Milk)
4 Eggs
1/2 cup Sugar
1/4 cup Rum
1/2 tsp	 Salt
1 cup Raisin
1/4 cup Mixed Peels (cherries)
method:
1. Preheat oven to 350 F grease a 9 inch baking pan.
2. Combine butter and spices and butter the bread with this mixture on both sides. Stock the slices together and cut into 1 inch cubes.
3. Combine the coconut milk, eggs, sugar, rum, and salt.
4. Place the bread in a bowl and pour the milk mixture over the bread and leave to soak for 30 minutes. Stir in raisins.
5. Pour mixture into the baking pan and bake for 45 minutes or until done. Serve with caramel rum sauce.

title: Banana Cream For Banana Cake
ingredients:
1 Ripe Banana
1 oz. Sugar
1/4 tsp. Nutmeg
1/4 pint Cream, Whipped and Chilled (Evaporate milk can be used.)
method:
1.	Put banana, sugar and nutmeg in blender and blend until smooth
2.	Add to cream and serve with cake.

title: Victoria Sponge Cupcakes
ingredients:
Sponge Cupcakes
·	1 cup (8oz) unsalted butter room temperature
·	1 1/2 cup (210g) all-purpose flour
·	1 1/4 cup (250g) superfine sugar*
·	1 tablespoon and 1 teaspoon baking powder
·	1/2 teaspoon salt
·	4 large eggs room temperature
method:
1.	Preheat oven to 350°F and line cupcake pans.
2.	Place butter, sugar, flour, salt, baking powder, and eggs in your mixer and beat on low for 2 minutes until combined.
3.	Divide into 20 cupcake cups. Your cups should be filled about halfway full, as these cupcakes grow a lot! You should not have fewer than 20 filled cups or there will be overflow!
4.	Bake for 15-18 minutes until tops are golden.
5.	Allow to cool completely.

title: Hershey's Chocolate Cake
ingredients:
For the cake:
2 cups granulated sugar
1 3/4 cups all-purpose flour
3/4 cup Hershey's Cocoa Powder
1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder
1 1/2 teaspoons baking soda
1 teaspoon salt
2 large eggs
1 cup milk
1/2 cup vegetable oil
2 teaspoons vanilla extract
1 cup boiling water

For the frosting:
1/2 cup unsalted butter, softened
2/3 cup Hershey's Cocoa Powder
3 cups powdered sugar
1/3 cup milk
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
method:
1. Preheat the oven to 350°F. Grease and flour two 9-inch round cake pans.
2. In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the sugar, flour, cocoa powder, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
3. Add the eggs, milk, vegetable oil, and vanilla extract to the dry ingredients and mix until well combined.
4. Gradually stir in the boiling water, mixing until the batter is smooth.
5. Divide the batter evenly between the prepared cake pans.
6. Bake for 30-35 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the center of the cakes comes out clean.
7. Let the cakes cool in the pans for 10 minutes before removing them from the pans and placing them on wire racks to cool completely.
8. While the cakes are cooling, prepare the frosting. In a large mixing bowl, beat the butter until creamy.
9. Add the cocoa powder, powdered sugar, milk, and vanilla extract to the butter and beat until well combined and creamy.
10. Once the cakes are completely cooled, spread a layer of frosting on one of the cakes, then top it with the other cake. Spread the remaining frosting over the top and sides of the cake.

title: Boston Cream Pie
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder
1/4 teaspoon salt
3/4 cup granulated sugar
1/3 cup unsalted butter, at room temperature
2 large eggs
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
1/2 cup whole milk

For the custard:
1/2 cup granulated sugar
1/4 cup cornstarch
1/4 teaspoon salt
2 cups whole milk
4 large egg yolks
2 teaspoons vanilla extract
1/4 cup unsalted butter

For the chocolate glaze:
1/2 cup heavy cream
1 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips
method:
1. Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C). Grease and flour two 9-inch (23 cm) cake pans.
2. In a medium bowl, sift together flour, baking powder, and salt. Set aside.
3. In a large bowl, cream together butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Stir in vanilla.
4. Add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture in three parts, alternating with the milk, starting and ending with the dry ingredients. Mix until just combined.
5. Divide the batter evenly between the two prepared pans. Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the center of the cakes comes out clean.
6. Let the cakes cool in the pans for 5 minutes, then remove them from the pans and place them on wire racks to cool completely.

Custard
1. To make the custard, combine the sugar, cornstarch, and salt in a medium saucepan. Gradually whisk in the milk, making sure there are no lumps. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens and comes to a boil. Boil for 1-2 minutes, then remove from heat.
2. In a small bowl, whisk together the egg yolks and vanilla. Gradually whisk in about a cup of the hot milk mixture. Pour the egg mixture back into the saucepan with the remaining milk mixture and whisk until well combined.
3. Return the saucepan to the stove and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the custard thickens and comes to a boil. Boil for 1-2 minutes, then remove from heat and stir in the butter until it is melted and well combined.
4. Pour the custard into a clean bowl and cover it with plastic wrap, making sure the wrap is in contact with the surface of the custard. Refrigerate until chilled.
5. To assemble the cake, place one of the cooled cake layers on a plate. Spread the chilled custard over the cake layer, leaving a small border around the edge.
6. Place the second cake layer on top of the custard, pressing down lightly.

Chocolate glaze
1. To make the chocolate glaze, heat the heavy cream in a small saucepan until it just begins to simmer. Remove from heat and add the chocolate chips. Let sit for 1-2 minutes, then whisk until smooth.
2. Pour the chocolate glaze over the top of the cake, spreading it evenly over the top and letting it drip down the sides.
3. Refrigerate the cake until the glaze is set, then slice and serve.

title: Pumpkin Spice Cake
ingredients:
For the cake:
2 cups all-purpose flour
1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder
1 teaspoon baking soda
1/2 teaspoon salt
2 teaspoons ground cinnamon
1/2 teaspoon ground ginger
1/4 teaspoon ground cloves
1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg
1/2 cup unsalted butter, softened
1 1/2 cups granulated sugar
2 large eggs
1 cup canned pumpkin puree
1/2 cup whole milk

For the cream cheese frosting:
8 ounces cream cheese, softened
1/2 cup unsalted butter, softened
3 cups powdered sugar
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
method:
1. Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and flour two 9-inch (23 cm) cake pans.
2. In a medium bowl, sift together the flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, cinnamon, ginger, cloves, and nutmeg. Set aside.
3. In a large bowl, cream together the butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add the eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Stir in the pumpkin puree.
4. Add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture in three parts, alternating with the milk, starting and ending with the dry ingredients. Mix until just combined.
5. Divide the batter evenly between the two prepared pans. Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the center of the cakes comes out clean.
6. Let the cakes cool in the pans for 5 minutes, then remove them from the pans and place them on wire racks to cool completely.

Cream cheese frosting
1. To make the cream cheese frosting, cream together the cream cheese and butter until smooth. Gradually add the powdered sugar and vanilla extract, mixing until well combined.
2. Once the cakes have cooled completely, place one of the cake layers on a cake stand or serving plate. Spread a generous layer of frosting on top of the cake layer. Place the second cake layer on top of the frosting and press down gently to secure it in place.
3. Use the remaining frosting to cover the top and sides of the cake, smoothing it out with a spatula or knife.
Optional: sprinkle some chopped pecans or walnuts on top of the cake for some extra crunch and flavor.
Note: You can also add some pumpkin spice to the cream cheese frosting for an extra pop of flavor. Simply mix in 1-2 teaspoons of pumpkin spice to the frosting recipe.

title: Philadelphia Classic Cheesecake
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs
1/3 cup granulated sugar
1/2 cup unsalted butter, melted
4 (8-ounce) packages cream cheese, softened
1 1/4 cups granulated sugar
2 teaspoons vanilla extract
4 large eggs, at room temperature
2/3 cup sour cream, at room temperature
method:
1. Preheat the oven to 350°F. Lightly grease a 9-inch springform pan.
2. In a medium bowl, mix together the graham cracker crumbs, 1/3 cup sugar, and melted butter. Press the mixture evenly into the bottom of the prepared pan.
3. In a large mixing bowl, beat the cream cheese, 1 1/4 cups sugar, and vanilla extract until smooth and creamy. Beat in the eggs, one at a time, until fully incorporated. Stir in the sour cream.
4. Place the springform pan into a larger baking pan and add hot water to the larger pan until it reaches about halfway up the sides of the springform pan.
5. Bake the cheesecake for 50 to 60 minutes, or until the edges are set and the center is still slightly jiggly. Turn off the oven and let the cheesecake cool inside for 30 minutes.
6. Remove the cheesecake from the oven and allow it to cool completely on a wire rack.
7. Chill the cheesecake in the refrigerator for at least 4 hours, or overnight

title: Oreo Mini Cheesecakes
ingredients:
2 (8 ounce) packages cream cheese, softened
2 eggs, beaten.
1/2 cup white sugar
24 chocolate sandwich cookies (such as Oreo)
24 mini-muffin cups / liners
method:
Move oven rack to middle tier and preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Line 24 mini-muffin cups with miniature paper liners.
Beat cream cheese, eggs, and sugar together in a bowl until smooth.
Put 1 cookie into the bottom of each paper liner. Spoon the cream cheese mixture atop the cookies.
Bake in preheated oven until nearly set in the middle, about 15 minutes.
Move tins to a wire rack to cool slightly before refrigerating until the cheesecake layer sets firmly, about 3 hours

title: Rum And Raisin Cheesecake
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs
1/4 cup granulated sugar
6 tablespoons unsalted butter, melted

For the filling:
24 oz. cream cheese, softened
1 cup granulated sugar
3 large eggs
1/2 cup raisins
1/4 cup dark rum
1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract

For the topping:
1/2 cup heavy cream
1/4 cup granulated sugar
1/4 cup dark rum
1/4 cup raisins
method:
1. Preheat the oven to 325°F. Grease a 9-inch springform pan and line the bottom with parchment paper.
2. In a medium mixing bowl, stir together the graham cracker crumbs, sugar, and melted butter until well combined. Press the mixture into the bottom of the prepared pan, using a flat-bottomed glass or measuring cup to pack it down evenly.
3. In a large mixing bowl, beat the cream cheese and sugar together until creamy.
4. Beat in the eggs one at a time, mixing until each egg is fully incorporated.
5. In a small saucepan, combine the raisins and rum over medium heat. Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until the raisins have plumped up and the rum has been absorbed.
6. Stir the raisin mixture and vanilla extract into the cheesecake batter until well combined.
7. Pour the cheesecake batter over the prepared crust.
8. Bake the cheesecake for 50-60 minutes, or until the centre is just set and the edges are lightly browned.
9. Let the cheesecake cool completely in the pan, then refrigerate it for at least 2 hours or overnight.
10. To make the topping, heat the heavy cream and sugar together in a small saucepan over medium heat, stirring until the sugar has dissolved.
11. Stir in the rum and raisins and continue to heat the mixture until it has thickened slightly.
12. Let the topping cool to room temperature, then spread it over the top of the chilled cheesecake.

title: Baileys Rum Cheesecake
ingredients:
For the crust:
2 cups chocolate cookie crumbs (such as Oreos)
1/4 cup granulated sugar
1/2 cup unsalted butter, melted

For the filling:
32 oz. cream cheese, softened
1 1/4 cups granulated sugar
4 large eggs
1/2 cup Baileys Irish Cream liqueur
1/4 cup rum
1 teaspoon vanilla extract

For the topping:
1 cup heavy cream
1/4 cup granulated sugar
1/4 cup Baileys Irish Cream liqueur
method:
1. Preheat the oven to 325°F. Grease a 9-inch springform pan and line the bottom with parchment paper.
2. In a medium mixing bowl, stir together the chocolate cookie crumbs, sugar, and melted butter until well combined.
3. Press the mixture into the bottom of the prepared pan, using a flat-bottomed glass or measuring cup to pack it down evenly.
4. In a large mixing bowl, beat the cream cheese and sugar together until creamy.
5. Beat in the eggs one at a time, mixing until each egg is fully incorporated.
6. Stir in the Baileys Irish Cream liqueur, rum, and vanilla extract until well combined.
7. Pour the cheesecake batter over the prepared crust.
8. Bake the cheesecake for 60-70 minutes, or until the center is just set and the edges are lightly browned.
9. Let the cheesecake cool completely in the pan, then refrigerate it for at least 2 hours or overnight.
10. To make the topping, heat the heavy cream and sugar together in a small saucepan over medium heat, stirring until the sugar has dissolved.
11. Remove the mixture from the heat and stir in the Baileys Irish Cream liqueur.
12. Let the topping cool to room temperature, then spread it over the top of the chilled cheesecake.
Optional: garnish with chocolate shavings or whipped cream before serving.

title: Berry Cheesecake
ingredients:
For the crust:
1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs
1/4 cup granulated sugar
6 tablespoons unsalted butter, melted

For the filling:
24 oz. cream cheese, softened
1 cup granulated sugar
3 large eggs
1/2 cup sour cream
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
1 cup mixed berries (such as raspberries, blueberries, and strawberries), fresh or frozen

For the berry topping:
2 cups mixed berries, fresh or frozen
1/2 cup granulated sugar
2 tablespoons cornstarch
1/4 cup water
method:
1. Preheat the oven to 325°F. Grease a 9-inch springform pan and line the bottom with parchment paper.
2. In a medium mixing bowl, stir together the graham cracker crumbs, sugar, and melted butter until well combined.
3. Press the mixture into the bottom of the prepared pan, using a flat-bottomed glass or measuring cup to pack it down evenly.
4. In a large mixing bowl, beat the cream cheese and sugar together until creamy.
5. Beat in the eggs one at a time, mixing until each egg is fully incorporated.
6. Stir in the sour cream and vanilla extract until well combined.
7. Fold in the mixed berries gently.
8. Pour the cheesecake batter over the prepared crust.
9. Bake the cheesecake for 50-60 minutes, or until the center is just set and the edges are lightly browned.
10. Let the cheesecake cool completely in the pan, then refrigerate it for at least 2 hours or overnight.
11. To make the berry topping, combine the berries, sugar, and cornstarch in a medium saucepan.
12. Stir in the water and bring the mixture to a simmer over medium heat.
13. Cook the mixture for 5-7 minutes, or until the berries have softened and the sauce has thickened.
14. Remove the berry topping from the heat and let it cool to room temperature.
15. Once cooled, pour the berry topping over the chilled cheesecake.
Optional: garnish with additional fresh berries before serving.

title: Carrot Cake Cheesecake
ingredients:
For the carrot cake layer:
2 cups all-purpose flour
2 teaspoons baking powder
1 1/2 teaspoons ground cinnamon
1/2 teaspoon ground ginger
1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg
1/2 teaspoon salt
1 cup vegetable oil
1 1/4 cups granulated sugar
3 large eggs
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
2 cups finely grated carrots

For the cheesecake layer:
16 oz. cream cheese, softened
1 1/2 teaspoon all-purpose flour
1/2 cup granulated sugar
2 large eggs
1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract

For the cream cheese frosting:
8 oz. cream cheese, softened
1/4 cup unsalted butter, softened
2 cups powdered sugar
1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract
method:
Carrot cake
1. Preheat the oven to 350°F. Grease a 9-inch springform pan and line the bottom with parchment paper.
2. In a medium mixing bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg, and salt.
3. In a large mixing bowl, beat together the oil, sugar, eggs, and vanilla extract until well combined.
4. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until just combined.
5. Stir in the grated carrots.
6. Pour the carrot cake batter into the prepared pan and smooth the top with a spatula.

Cheese cake
7. In a separate mixing bowl, beat the cream cheese and sugar together until creamy.
8. Beat in the eggs and vanilla extract until well combined.
9. Pour the cheesecake batter over the carrot cake layer in the pan.
10. Bake the cake for 50-60 minutes, or until the cheesecake layer is set and the carrot cake layer is fully baked. The center should be slightly jiggly.
11. Let the cake cool completely in the pan, then refrigerate it for at least 2 hours or overnight.
12. To make the cream cheese frosting, beat the cream cheese and butter together until creamy.
13. Gradually add the powdered sugar and vanilla extract, beating until the frosting is smooth and creamy.
14. Once the cake is chilled, remove it from the pan and spread the cream cheese frosting over the top.

title: Plain Cake
ingredients:

1/2 salt
method:
1. Cream margarine 'and sugar until light and fluffy
2. Add egg one at a time beating well after each addition. Add vanilla.
3. Sift flour and baking powder together and add alternately with to cream mixture.
4. Pour into grease 9-inch pan bake at 350°f for about 45 minutes.

title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
ingredients:
1 tablespoon butter
1/4 Cup Brown Sugar
9 Canned Pineapple slices
9 Drained Cherries
1 1/4 cups sifted Flour.
1 1/2 tsp. Baking Powder
1/4 Cup Shortening
3/4 Granulated Sugar
2 Eggs Beaten
1/2 Cup Milk
1 tsp. Vanilla
method:
1. Grease bottom of frying pan with shortening and lime with greaseproof Paper.
2. Melt butter in pan at 220 F.
3. Sprinkle brown sugar over melted butter.
4. Arrange pineapple slices with cherries in centre of the slices and arrange over butter mixture. Set aside.
5. Sift together next 3 ingredients (flour, baking powder and salt.)
6. Beat shortening until creamy.
7. Add granulated sugar and continue beating.
8. Add eggs and beat well.
9. Add flour with milk and vanilla, stirring until smooth after each addition.
10. Spread on fruit.
11. Bake for 30 minutes, at 260 F
12. Let stand for 5 minutes before turning out.

title: Pumpkin Cake
ingredients:

 3 Eggs

method:

3. Sift together remaining dry ingredients, ad to shortening mixture. Beat well, pour evenly into prepared pans.
4.  bake for 40 to 45 minutes or until done

title: Carrot Cake (II)
ingredients:
For the cake:
2 cups all-purpose flour
2 teaspoons baking powder
1 1/2 teaspoons baking soda
1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
1/2 teaspoon ground ginger
1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg
1/2 teaspoon salt
1 1/2 cups granulated sugar
1 cup vegetable oil
4 large eggs
2 cups grated carrots (about 4-5 medium carrots)
1 cup chopped walnuts or pecans (optional)

For the cream cheese frosting:
8 oz. cream cheese, softened
1/2 cup unsalted butter, softened
3-4 cups powdered sugar
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
method:
1. Preheat the oven to 350°F. Grease two 9-inch round cake pans and line the bottoms with parchment paper.
2. In a medium mixing bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg, and salt until well combined.
3. In a large mixing bowl, beat the sugar and oil together until well combined.
4. Beat in the eggs one at a time, mixing until each egg is fully incorporated.
5. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until just combined.
6. Fold in the grated carrots and chopped nuts, if using.
7. Divide the batter evenly between the prepared cake pans.
8. Bake the cakes for 30-35 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
9. Let the cakes cool in the pans for 10 minutes, then remove them from the pans and let them cool completely on wire racks.
10. To make the cream cheese frosting, beat the cream cheese and butter together in a large mixing bowl until creamy.
11. Gradually beat in the powdered sugar until the frosting is smooth and fluffy.
12. Beat in the vanilla extract until well combined.
13. Once the cakes have cooled completely, place one cake layer on a serving plate or cake stand.
14. Spread a layer of frosting over the top of the cake layer.
15. Place the second cake layer on top of the frosting.
16. Spread a layer of frosting over the top and sides of the cake, using an offset spatula to smooth the frosting as you go.
Optional: garnish the cake with additional chopped nuts or shredded carrots.

title: Pound Cake
ingredients:
1 lb Margarine
1 lb Sugar

title: White Chocolate Buttercream
ingredients:
250 g unsalted butter - soft at room temperature
250 g icing sugar
200 g white chocolate
A little milk - to get the buttercream to the right consistency, this may not be needed
method:
1. Break the white chocolate (200g) and melt it in a bowl over a pan of simmering water
2. Once the chocolate has melted, remove the bowl from the pan and leave the chocolate to cool.
3. Beat the butter (250g) on a low speed until soft and then add the icing sugar (250g), 1 tbsp at a time and beat until fully combined.
4. Once the white chocolate has cooled to room temperature pour it into the butter and sugar mixture and beat on a low speed until fully combined. You should find that the buttercream has a soft, spreadable consistency, if not add a little milk a tsp at a time until it is soft.
5. Your buttercream is now ready to use.

title: Coffee Buttercream
ingredients:
8 oz softened butter
16 oz icing sugar
1/4 tsp vanilla extract
3 tbsp instant coffee granules
1 1/2 tbsp boiling water
method:
1. Mix the instant coffee granules (3 tbsp) with the boiling water (11/2 tbsp) and then set aside to cool.
2. Cut the butter (250g) into cubes and then beat on a low-medium speed until soft. Gradually add the icing sugar (you add it gradually to stop it flying everywhere) and beat until fully combined.
3. Add the vanilla extract (1\4 tsp) and add the coffee a teaspoon at a time, beating in each addition before adding more.
4. Check the consistency of your buttercream. It should be soft and perfect for piping at this point. If it's still a little stiff then beat in a little
Make sure you leave your butter out of the fridge to soften before attempting to make buttercream, otherwise it'll be tricky to get it really smooth. I usually take mine out a couple of hours before I'm planning on using it. Make sure you let your coffee cool completely before adding it to the buttercream (otherwise it'll melt the butter). Add the coffee very gradually and beat each addition in before adding more. This will help ensure that you get a nice smooth buttercream.
Beat your buttercream on a low-medium speed. It's tempting to turn the speed up high to get it made quicker but you'll end up with lots of air bubbles. If you can, try and mix it by hand for a really smooth consistency. If your buttercream is still a little too thick once you've added all your coffee, add a little milk to get it to the right consistency.

title: Caramel Buttercream
ingredients:
150 g butter - soft at room temperature
150 g icing sugar
150 g caramel sauce
method:
1. Cut the butter (150g) into cubes and then beat it (by hand or with an electric mixer on a low speed) until soft.
2. Beat in the icing sugar (150g) (I do this a tablespoon at a time to avoid it flying everywhere and covering my kitchen).
3. Once the butter and icing sugar are fully combined, beat in the caramel sauce (150g).

NOTES
This recipe makes enough icing for 9 cupcakes (decorated as in the pictures) or to cover and fill a 7" (17.5cm) round layer cake. You can find the recipe for the caramel cupcakes hiding under the caramel buttercream here. If you fancy using a different flavour of cupcake you can find all of my recipes in my cupcake index.
If you're making your own caramel sauce to use in this recipe then make it in advance and leave it in the fridge to cool completely before using it for your buttercream. Make sure your butter is soft (but not melted) before you start.  If your buttercream starts to get a little soft then pop it into the fridge for 10-15 minutes to firm up a little before using it.

title: Boiled Frosting
ingredients:

3\4 Cup sugar icing

method:

title: Fondant
method:
INGREDIENTS
6lb Sugar
8 oz. Water
2oz. Glucose Or 0.5 oz Cream of Tartar
INSTRUCTIONS
1. Clean a marble slab well and moisten it with water. Set four steel bars on the slab in the shape of a square to hold the hot syrup when it is poured onto the marble.
2. Combine the sugar and water in a heavy kettle and heat to dissolve the sugar. Boil until the temperature reaches 225°F (100° C).
3. If glucose is used, warm it. If cream of tartar is used, disperse it in a little warm water. Add the glucose or the cream of tartar to the boiling syrup
4. Continue to the syrup until it reaches 240°F (115°C).
5. Pour the boiling syrup onto the marble slab and sprinkle it with a h. water to prevent crystallization.
6. Let the syrup cool undisturbed to about 110°F (43 °C).
7. Remove the steel and work the sugar with a steel scraper, turning it from the outside to the centre. It will turn white and begin to solidify.
8. Continue to work the fondant, either by hand or by putting it in a mixing bowl and working it slowly with the paddle attachment, until it is smooth and creamy.
9. Keep the fondant in a tight covered container
HOW TO USE
1. Heat fondant over a warm water bath, stirring constantly, to thin out the icing and make it pourable. Do not heat it over 100° F (38°C) or it will lose its shine. If it is still too thick, thin it out with a little simple sugar syrup or water.
2. Flavourings and colourings may be added as desired.
3. To make chocolate fondant, stir melted bitter chocolate into warm fondant until the desired colour and flavour are reached (up to about 3.oz. Bitter chocolate per lb fondant, or 190 g per kg). Chocolate will thicken the fondant, so the icing may require more thinning with sugar syrup.
4. Apply the warm fondant by pouring it over the item or by dipping item into it.
Fondant
INGREDIENT

 2 tbsp Corn-starch

INSTRUCTIONS

5. Then add ½ cup corn syrup
6. Put on stove and heat until it dissolves stirring constantly. DO NOT LET IT BOIL
7. Kneed in remaining sugar a little at a time
8. Base cake with corn syrup. Sprinkle cornstarch on counter top and roll out fondant to cover cake.

Fondant Icing
INGREDIENTS
1 tbsp Glycerine
1 tbsp Gelatine
1/2 cup liquid Glucose
Y4 cup cold water
2 lbs Icing Sugar
Corn starch
 1 egg white
INSTRUCTIONS
1. Combine Gelatine and cold water, let stand until thick until dissolved.
2. Place Glycerine in bowl
3. Measure out liquid glucose and add in bowl and place in top of double boiler.
4. Heat until dissolved or mixture becomes watery.
5. Stir in shortening and just before completely melted remove from heat (can add flavouring or colour to this mixture if needed).
6. Separate the icing sugar into 2 equal parts (1 lb each in separate bowls)
7. Make a well in the icing sugar in one of the bowl and add Gelatine mixture and stir with a spoon, mixing in sugar and adding more from next bowl, a little at a time, until thickness disappear.
8. Knead in remaining sugar until is smooth and does not stick to your hands.
9. Base cake with egg white then cover cake with icing

title: Candy Glass
ingredients:
3 3/4 cups granulated sugar
1 1/2 cups light corn syrup
1 cup water
1/2 tsp cream of tartar
Food coloring (optional)
method:
1. Grease a baking sheet with cooking spray and set aside.
2. In a large saucepan, combine the sugar, corn syrup, water, and cream of tartar. Stir to combine.
3. Over medium heat, bring the mixture to a boil without stirring. Use a candy thermometer to monitor the temperature and continue boiling until it reaches 300°F (150°C). This should take about 20-25 minutes.
4. Once the mixture reaches 300°F (150°C), remove it from heat and stir in food coloring if desired.
5. Pour the mixture onto the prepared baking sheet, and use a spatula to spread it evenly. Be careful, as the mixture will be very hot and sticky.
6. Let the sugar glass cool and harden at room temperature for at least 1 hour, or until completely set.
7. Once the sugar glass has hardened, break it into desired shapes and sizes. You can use it to decorate cakes, cupcakes, or any other dessert that needs a touch of extra sweetness.
